data.technicalDescription: Bought <color=#A3FFFE>Planets</color> also count towards Bought <color=#A3FFFE>Data Centers</color>.

data.description: "Glory to your planets". The new galactic mega corporation motto, that surprisingly reduces the cost of getting more planets. Maybe you should come out with more of them.
data.technicalDescription: Total <color=#A3FFFE>Planets</color> reduce the <color=#A3FFFE>cost</color> of bought <color=#A3FFFE>Planets</color>.

data.description: Okay, the description is a bit misleading. Your planets aren't weak nor crippled, they are just sanctuaries for the smaller and weaker members of your empire (your AI Managers, in this case).
data.technicalDescription: Bought <color=#A3FFFE>Planets</color> also count towards bought <color=#A3FFFE>AI Managers</color>.

data.description: You aren't quite sure why, but every planet you manually spend resources to get shines bright like a diamond. It might have to do with bombing the planet afterwards with metric tons of diamonds.
data.technicalDescription: Bought <color=#A3FFFE>Planets</color> now count <color=#A3FFFE>Twelve Times</color>.

data.description: Earth is threatened with extinction in the year 2149. The Shannon family transport themselves back a million years, where colonies of humans have a second chance to build a civilisation.
data.technicalDescription: <color=#A3FFFE>Planet Boost</color> effect also reduces the <color=#A3FFFE>Cost</color> of new <color=#A3FFFE>Planets</color>.

data.description: There aren't any planets like yours. And that's because you are amazing! Also because each planet is filled to the brim with Assembly Lines, Managers, Servers and Data Centers.
data.technicalDescription: Bought <color=#A3FFFE>Planets</color> also count towards bought <color=#A3FFFE>Assembly Lines</color>.

data.description: You find a fragment of another universe. You use this knowledge to discover new Planets, I wonder what other parts of this universe you can find?
data.technicalDescription: Assemble an additional <color=#A3FFFE>Planet</color> per second. Get an additional <color=#A3FFFE>Planet</color> for every other purchased <color=#A3FFFE>Fragment Skill</color>.

data.description: Pushing the limits is what you do best.
data.technicalDescription: Increase the production multiplier from <color=#A3FFFE>3%</color> to <color=#A3FFFE>5%</color>

data.description: Lowering Suspicion allows... wait, wrong game.
data.technicalDescription: Get <color=#A3FFFE>10x</color> as many <color=#A3FFFE>Servers</color> from <color=#A3FFFE>Rudimentary Singularity</color>.

data.description: Stuff happens, and your production layout is prepared for everything and anything. This allows for a flexible production boost, boosting the highest and the lowest layer of the dyson swarm.
data.technicalDescription: You now produce <color=#A3FFFE>50%</color> more <color=#A3FFFE>AI Managers</color>. Additionally, after <color=#A3FFFE>100 Planets</color>, <color=#A3FFFE>Planets</color> production boosted by <color=#A3FFFE>50%</color>

data.description: Sick of imagining what could have been you decide to put your imagination into action.
data.technicalDescription: <color=#A3FFFE>Shoulders of Giants</color> now additionally work off <color=#A3FFFE>Pocket Dimensions</color>.

data.description: Death, life, death, life. An eternal loop of what will come to pass. Being prepared not only helps your psychology, but also your pocket dimensions.
data.technicalDescription: Every bought <color=#A3FFFE>Data Center</color> gives a <color=#A3FFFE>1%</color> boost to production of <color=#A3FFFE>Data Centers</color>.

data.description: Additional worker bots can now be used as home assistants... At a cost of course!
data.technicalDescription: For every <color=#A3FFFE>1%</color> invested in <color=#A3FFFE>Workers</color>, <color=#A3FFFE>+100%</color> <color=#A3FFFE>Cash</color> production.

data.description: CPU upgrades allow your workers to operate additional arms, making them twice as effective.
data.technicalDescription: Multiplies <color=#A3FFFE>Panel</color> production by <color=#A3FFFE>2</color>.

data.description: Worthy Sacrifice is a legendary trade-off, balancing panel longevity for efficient assembly. It requires bold leadership and a deep understanding of organizational values. A symbol of determination and strategic thinking, it is remembered as a tale of calculated risk-taking.
data.technicalDescription: <color=#A3FFFE>Panel Lifetime</color> will be reduced by <color=#A3FFFE>50%</color>, but <color=#A3FFFE>Assembly Lines</color> will be <color=#A3FFFE>5x</color> as effective.
